text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates bus service on Ameer Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting City Council to authorize the installation of all-way stop control at the intersection of Ameer Avenue and Regina Avenue. The installation of all-way stop control is justified to clearly establish the right-of-way and to enhance pedestrian and vehicular safety at this intersection.
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way stop control at the intersection of Ameer Avenue and Regina Avenue.
